src/recording/exporter_fit.rs.description: Added export_fit_with_workout() function for workout-aware FIT export. Takes optional Workout and uses segment durations as lap boundaries. Also added extract_workout_segment_durations() helper. Both functions are exported via recording/mod.rs.

src/ui/screens/ride_summary.rs.description: Export dialog (lines 430-487) only shows TCX and CSV options. Need to add FIT as third radio option. Uses ExportFormat from recording::types which already includes Fit variant.

src/ui/screens/ride_detail.rs.description: Has duplicate local ExportFormat enum (lines 31-38) with only Tcx and Csv. Should use crate::recording::types::ExportFormat instead to get FIT support.

src/daemon/handler.rs.description: Updated handle_ride_export function to properly validate and route FIT/TCX/CSV export requests. Uses ExportFormat enum for type-safe format handling. Defaults to FIT format. Database integration for actual export is pending (marked with TODO).

src/ipc/messages.rs.description: Added InvalidFormat error code to ErrorCode enum for handling invalid export format requests. Used when user specifies a format other than fit, tcx, or csv.

tests/unit/fit_export_test.rs.description: Added 26 comprehensive multi-interval workout lap marker roundtrip tests. Tests cover: lap count verification (2, 5, 20 intervals), lap timestamps sequential ordering, session num_laps field matching, lap field presence (avg_power, avg_heart_rate, total_elapsed_time), lap event type validation, short/long interval boundaries, samples shorter/longer than workout duration, explicit lap boundaries, LapData computation accuracy, and segment duration boundary alignment. Uses fitparser crate to validate exported FIT files are parseable and contain expected data.

tests/integration/fit_validation_test.rs.description: Comprehensive FIT validation integration tests using fitparser crate. Validates: FIT header (size, protocol version, signature), CRC verification (header and file), required message types (FileId, Session, Lap, Activity, Record, Event), data integrity fields, multi-lap exports, cycling dynamics, large rides (up to 2 hours), and edge cases. Equivalent to Garmin FIT SDK validation.

scripts/validate_fit.sh.description: Shell script for manual FIT file validation. Supports validating individual FIT files or running full test suite with --all flag. Uses fitparser via integration tests for validation.
